Coreference rules the anaphoric definite 'the quarter' onto its most salient compatible antecedent — the first quarter introduced two clauses earlier — so minting sk_quarter_2 posits a second quarter the sentence does not state.

Dropping 'based' is lossy but nothing false or over-asserted results, the head On is the preposition actually present in the text, and clause-level participial complex prepositions are the coverage gap the reviewer files themselves.
